name: take checks the queue and stops in two lock sections
replace:
ELSE LET p == IF phase = "draining" THEN "stopped" ELSE phase
            IN /\ phase' = p
               /\ lpc' = IF p = "stopped" THEN "close" ELSE "wait"
               /\ UNCHANGED <<cur, queue>>

CheckStop ==
  /\ lpc = "check"
  /\ LET p == IF phase = "draining" THEN "stopped" ELSE phase
     IN /\ phase' = p
        /\ lpc' = IF p = "stopped" THEN "close" ELSE "wait"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, wake, done, cur, ran, sub, spc>>

Loop == CheckStop \/ Take \/
